txns.gain_basis: DERIVED (FLAGGED) vs_book_value = (sale_price 6,650,000 - carrying_value 6,208,000)/6,208,000 = +7.12%. No premium%/gain% disclosed in AR. CAUTION: at ACRO-BT (cost-model) level a 'Net loss on disposition of property, plant and equipment' of US$(127)k was recognised (Note 11, p.133; also P&L p.98); at Stapled level (revaluation model) no P&L gain/loss arises ('-' in Note 11 Stapled column), so the +7.1% reflects sale price vs Stapled held-for-sale carrying, while the disclosed accounting outcome was a (127) loss at ACRO-BT. Cash proceeds from disposition were US$6,207k (Cash Flow Statement, Stapled, p.105) vs US$6,650k gross consideration.
